item.title: NEXUS — Provider Rebrand + Player & Settings Overhaul
item.description:
NEXUS old build received a full refresh (Sep 5, 2026). Here's everything that changed:
**Provider Rebrand & Reorder** - Crimson 4K (was ShowBox) - Scepter (was CastleTV) - ZyPhed (was ZXCStreams) - Scythe (was OneTouchTV) - Oblivion (was NetMirror) - Kinetic (was Videasy) - Apex (was VaPlayer) - All providers keep their original functionality & backend id — only the name and priority order changed
**Player (Nexus 3.0 experience)** - Cast to device now works for every source (removed the old 'artemis-only' gate) - Chromecast & AirPlay pick the correct stream automatically - Download, Watch Party, Subtitles, Audio, Quality and Skip Segments menus match the NEXUS 3.0 layout
**Settings** - New 'Advertisements' category added right below 'Connections' (easy to find) - The 'Disable advertisements' toggle lives there and actually hides all ads across the site - 'Last used source' and 'Auto resume on playback error' are now ON by default (you can turn them off anytime)
**Subtitle menu fix** - Fixed the auto-select subtitle option that was showing as a raw key ('player.menus.subtitles.autoSelectChoice') — now displays proper English text
**Reliability** - Restored missing player modules (keyboard shortcuts, casting, watch-party sync, popup guard) - Re-joined the player store's casting slice and interface flags - Added 9 TMDB helpers the notification scheduler relies on - Added missing icons (Translate, thumbs up/down)
Enjoy the faster, rebranded NEXUS! 🍿
